sql: select split_part(event_ticker,$$-$$,1) as series, strike_type, count(*) n, count(distinct event_ticker) ev, count(distinct market_ticker) mk, count(distinct captured_at) caps, min(minutes_to_close)::int mtc_min, max(minutes_to_close)::int mtc_max, count(trailing_move_15m) n_move, round(avg(yes_ask_cents-yes_bid_cents)::numeric,2) spr, sum(case when mid_cents between 10 and 90 then 1 else 0 end) n_mid10_90 from crypto_ladder_snapshots where event_ticker >= $$KX$$ and event_ticker like $$%-26NOV04%$$ group by 1,2 order by 1,2
